test_title: PYST 26: SSC JE ME - Reasoning (Held on: 22 March 2021 (Morning)
subject: reasoning
question:
A cube is made by folding the given sheet. In the cube formed, which of the following pairs of letters will be on opposite sides?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/184a4a9491e0941e6965a9feb8b1bdac8e041a4dec6519a92066d0ab8ed1c7d5.png]
solution:
Faces opposite to each other is shown below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4fd19acf09c8a54443bdfde2df852ad57d57b4490df272650e7eb82e174470b5.png] 

On folding the cube, the following faces are opposite to each other:

1) ‘T’ is opposite to ‘W’

2) ‘U’ is opposite to ‘X’

3) ‘V’ is opposite to ‘Z’

Therefore, V is opposite Z.

Hence, the correct answer is **"V and Z".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Dices are of two types :

 
• Standard Dice
 
• Non-Standard Dice.

 
• Dice has:-

 
• faces = 6
 
• sides = 12
 
• corners = 8

 
• Two opposite faces are never seen together.
 
• Adjacent faces are never the opposite of each other.
